exposure: COVID positive vs. COVID negative pregnant women
cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with COVID-19 compared to pregnant women who tested negative for COVID-19 and delivered during the same time frame at a COVID referral center.
finding: There was an increase in preterm delivery in COVID-19 positive pregnant women compared to COVID-19 negative pregnant women.
mod_finding: In the COVID positive group 18 (64.3%) out of 28 had c-section, whereas 40 (35.7%) out of 112 underwent cesarean section (p=0.006).
